{{Recipe summary
| Cuisine = Nigerian
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

'''Agbugbu''' is a typical igbo food made from pigeon peas and yam. It is tasty and easy to prepare.
==Ingredients==
*Dried [[Cookbook:Pigeon Pea|pigeon peas]]
*[[Cookbook:Yam|Yam]], cut into small pieces and rinsed
*Sliced [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*[[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|Ground crayfish]]
*Ground pepper
*[[Cookbook:Palm Oil|Palm oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste

==Procedure==
#Pick any dirt or debris out of the pigeon peas, then wash them and soak in water overnight.
#Drain away the soaking water.
#Cover the pigeon peas in fresh water, and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Cook until tender, then drain.
#Boil the yam in water until tender, then drain.
#Fry the onions, ground crayfish, ground pepper in a [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|pan]] with palm oil.
#Add the drained yam and pigeon peas, and stir gently.
#Season with salt to taste.
#Serve.
